name: omp-tools
description: OMP flexible ask adapter, generate_image with OpenAI (GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst) and Codex modes, and read-only /btw side questions

imageGenerationMode.description: Service and billing for generate_image. openai uses GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst with the openai API key and the API organization's billing; codex uses the ChatGPT/Codex login's image allowance. Applies to new sessions.

sideQuestionModel.description: Model for /btw and Picker btw. Use a role such as @smol or provider/model:level. Empty uses the main model.
